reviews.review:
With all due respect, They See Us is getting a big thumbs up from me. I haven’t really played any anomaly or horror games before, so this is one of the first “horror” experiences I’ve had. While I get that it isn’t full-on horror and relies more on a few jumpscares, I still really enjoyed it.

It took me around two hours to get through all the stages, but that’s mostly because my friends and I are a bunch of goons who don’t always notice everything right away. Even so, the experience was fun, engaging, and definitely worth the time.

As I’m writing this, the game hasn’t even been out for a month yet, so of course there are still some rough edges. But honestly, I can only see it improving with time. The foundation is solid, and I’m looking forward to seeing where the developers take it from here.

Overall: a solid start, fun with friends, and promising for the future.
